messages.subject: doubt with reactiveValues + observe
parts:
Hi guys,
I have found a problem and no idea to start with.

Run the following command:
runGist("https://gist.github.com/jzen188/8722480")

In this app, I have used reactiveValues + Observe to storage value...
If I tried to change the UI options fast in the web, sometimes there would be possible to repeat your previous control without end...
Such as, selected Variable 1(any) -> "Add to Plot" select change plot appearance ->
dragging the slider very fast and repeated
It would suddenly get repeated....
The textInput has also this kind of problem if I type something fast.....

Is that the reason I have used reactiveValues + Observe to storage value?
(The reason for this is I have made it switch the panel and only the particular UI group but hidden the others so I need reactiveValues to storage the previous input value and observe user return back and still see the previous options they had chosen were there...

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: doubt with reactiveValues + observe
parts:
I was able to get this to run--Junjie, you should change the line where you source add2tplot.R to stop using the absolute path and just use "add2tplot.R". Shiny always changed the working directory to the app directory when runApp/runGist is called.

I wasn't able to reproduce it repeating the previous "without end" but it does stack up all of the changes you asked for. Meaning, if you toggled quickly between two values one hundred times then it would flip back and forth 100 times no matter how long it takes. Does that explain what you're seeing?

BTW we're thinking about potentially changing this behavior in the future (or at least making it easier to specify what you want).

In fact, I found the problem is due to I do the following process:

observe({
optpar$XXX <- input$XXX

It is kind of recursively in the ui.R and server.R, add2tplot.R.

Thank you Joe.
